neighbours.label: an opening quotation mark or bracket that starts reported speech or an inserted clause after an introducing clause, not one around a single quoted word
fire: The governor stated that “we will rebuild the bridge by June”, officials confirmed.
La presidenta afirmó que “la crisis ya terminó” durante la conferencia.
El entrenador explicó que “el equipo jugó muy bien” tras el partido.
Le ministre a ajouté que « rien ne changera » lors du débat.
A spokesperson told reporters that “no one was hurt” in the fire.
Frankly, [the landlord] may just want more rent next year.
So let's suppose, [for instance] you own a small bakery.
Die Sprecherin sagte, „wir prüfen den Fall“ am Montag.
quiet: The governor stated that the bridge would be rebuilt by June, officials confirmed.
La presidenta afirmó que la crisis ya terminó durante la conferencia.
El entrenador compró un “nuevo” balón tras el partido.
